prior: per-environment, per-joint training mean and isotropic variance; global training fallback for unseen rooms or missing room joints
permutation_unit: complete accepted causal test window, within environment
rules: Freeze code/config/runtime/manifests/suite preregistration before any main suite test.json exists
Evaluate only after all twelve training jobs and original main suite evaluation complete
Use one fixed permutation per protocol, shared by baseline and temporal seed 2027
Carry predicted pose and log_sigma together; hold targets, masks and endpoint coverage fixed
Aligned PCK/NJE/counts must match original test report within 1e-6
No significance tests, tuning, model selection or training updates
Diagnostic may retain person, action and recording cues; not proof of causal motion or localization
